legend-tasmania-heritage-highway.slogan: Tasmania Heritage Highway – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-tasmania-heritage-highway.story: official tourism route. Georgian towns, farmland, historic bridges. A one-way ride of 171 km, Hobart to Launceston - roughly 3 h 07 in the saddle. On the way it passes Richmond and Tasmania Heritage Highway. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Tasmania Great Eastern Drive
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Tasmania Great Eastern Drive, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
